name: supabase-aws-sbg
description: Banco, autenticação e funções do site AWS Student Builder Groups (multi-grupo, Supabase).

scripts.functions:deploy: supabase functions deploy send-announcement && supabase functions deploy send-certificate && supabase functions deploy notify-publication
scripts.check:functions: for f in send-announcement send-certificate notify-publication studio-mcp; do npx -y deno check --node-modules-dir=none supabase/functions/$f/index.ts || exit 1; done
